verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community report that a user built a backend with "scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks" in n8n. That suggests the product has its own scheduling capability, but the pack contains no first-party schedule-trigger docs and says nothing about cron expressions or timezones. Missing for 10: documented cron-expression scheduling, timezone configuration (per-workflow or instance-level), first-party Schedule Trigger documentation, hands-on corroboration of schedule reliability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
